content: Mastodon: GET /api/v1/timelines/public and /api/v1/timelines/tag/:hashtag are public (keyless) unless the instance disables public preview (then app token + read:statuses required, since v3.0.0; v4.5.0 added per-instance access-control settings). Params: local, remote, only_media, limit (default 20, max 40), max_id/since_id/min_id; tag endpoint adds any[]/all[]/none[]. ~300 req/5min/IP. Live-verified keyless on mastodon.social 2026-07-08 (replies_count, reblogs_count, favourites_count, content HTML present).
